commute_time_minutes.source: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey, 2023
commute_time_minutes.note: One-way commute; up slightly from 26.6 pre-pandemic

working_hours_per_week.note: Average across all employed workers including part-time

lunch_break_minutes.note: Most workers take 30-40 min; 20% eat at their desk

leisure_hours_per_day.note: Includes TV, sports, socializing; men average 5.6h, women 4.7h

tv_hours_per_day.note: Linear + streaming; adults 18+; declines in younger cohorts

vacation_days_taken_per_year.note: Average available 19.8 days; ~$66B in unused vacation

overtime_culture.source: Gallup State of the American Workplace, 2023
overtime_culture.note: 43% of full-time workers say they work more than 45h/week

social_media_check_morning_pct.source: Pew Research Center Digital News Survey, 2024
social_media_check_morning_pct.note: Check phone within 30 min of waking

exercise_days_per_week.note: Adults meeting aerobic physical activity guidelines: 53%

avg_daily_steps.note: US ranks low globally despite fitness culture

housing_rent_or_mortgage_usd.source: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey / Zillow Rent Index, 2024
housing_rent_or_mortgage_usd.note: National median rent 1BR ~$1,500; mortgage payments avg higher

transport_usd.note: Includes car payments, insurance, gas, transit

education_usd.note: Household average; skewed by families with college students

healthcare_usd.note: Out-of-pocket + premiums; doesn't include employer contributions

savings_rate_pct.note: Personal saving rate; fell from pandemic high of 33% in 2020

debt_to_income_ratio_pct.source: Federal Reserve / New York Fed Consumer Credit Panel, 2024
debt_to_income_ratio_pct.note: Total household debt to disposable personal income

luxury_goods_spend_pct.note: Share of discretionary spending on premium/luxury

credit_card_debt_per_household_usd.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, 2024

individualism_score.note: Highest individualism score in the world

power_distance_score.note: Relatively low; egalitarian norms in workplace

personal_space_norm_m.source: Proxemics research / Hall's cultural model, applied 2022

tipping_culture.note: 72% say tipping expected at restaurants; tip inflation to 18-20% standard

hierarchy_importance.note: Scale 1-10; flatter structure preferred; 'can call boss by first name'

corruption_perception_index.note: Score 0-100; higher = less corrupt; ranked 24th globally

work_life_balance_score.note: Scale 1-10; ranks poorly among OECD nations

gender_pay_gap_pct.note: Women earn 82.9 cents per dollar; unadjusted gap

parental_leave_weeks.note: No federal paid parental leave; FMLA provides 12 wks unpaid

remote_work_policy_adoption_pct.note: Firms offering hybrid or remote options

major_religion.source: Pew Research Center Religious Landscape Study, 2023

weekly_religious_attendance_pct.note: Self-reported weekly church attendance; actual may be lower

religion_impact_daily_life.note: Scale 1-10; 45% say religion very important in their life

religious_holidays_count_per_year.note: Thanksgiving and Christmas; but Sunday culturally protected

religiosity_trend.note: Particularly among Gen Z; 'nones' projected to become plurality

top_platform_1.source: Pew Research Center Social Media Use, 2024

mobile_payment_adoption_pct.source: Federal Reserve Diary of Consumer Payment Choice, 2023
mobile_payment_adoption_pct.note: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo; below EU/China levels

online_banking_pct.source: FDIC National Survey of Unbanked and Underbanked, 2023

streaming_subscription_pct.note: Households with at least one streaming service

remote_work_pct.note: Workers who telework some or all days

ai_tool_adoption_pct.note: Adults who have used ChatGPT or similar; 23% use regularly

literacy_rate_pct.note: Adult literacy; functional literacy lower at ~54%

university_acceptance_rate_pct.note: Average across all 4-year institutions; Ivy League < 5%

student_loan_prevalence_pct.note: Percentage of college students borrowing; total debt $1.77T

stem_graduates_pct.note: STEM as share of bachelor's degrees conferred

vocational_track_pct.note: Share choosing vocational/CTE pathway post-high school

pisa_score_avg.note: Average of reading (504), math (465), science (499); below OECD avg in math

education_expenditure_per_student_usd.note: K-12 annual; highest among OECD nations

homeownership_rate_pct.source: U.S. Census Bureau Housing Vacancies Survey, Q4 2024

avg_rent_1br_city_usd.note: Median across major cities; NYC ~$3,200, Midwest ~$900

multigenerational_household_pct.note: Rising; driven by housing costs and immigration

housing_cost_to_income_ratio.source: Harvard Joint Center for Housing Studies, 2024

avg_home_size_sqm.source: U.S. Census Bureau New Residential Construction, 2023
avg_home_size_sqm.note: Largest in the world; median new home ~232 sqm

social_housing_pct.note: Public housing as share of stock; very low by OECD standards

housing_price_to_income_ratio.note: National median; severely unaffordable in coastal cities (>10)

avg_age_first_home_purchase.source: National Association of Realtors Profile of Buyers, 2023
avg_age_first_home_purchase.note: All-time high; driven by affordability crisis

home_cooking_pct.note: Meals prepared at home as share of total meals

obesity_rate_pct.note: Adults with BMI ≥ 30; highest in developed world

organic_food_adoption_pct.note: Households that purchase organic at least occasionally

meal_sharing_culture_score.note: Scale 1-10; individualistic meals common, but holidays communal

food_delivery_app_usage_pct.note: Adults who ordered food via app in past month

trust_in_govt_pct.note: Trust in federal government to do right; near historic low

trust_in_media_pct.note: Trust in mass media to report fully, accurately, fairly

trust_in_strangers_pct.note: Say most people can be trusted

press_freedom_index.note: Ranked 55th globally; score out of 100, higher = freer

northeast_vs_south_income_gap.value: Northeast median household income $78,400 vs South $62,100
northeast_vs_south_income_gap.note: New England and Mid-Atlantic consistently highest; Mississippi lowest at $52,900

coastal_vs_heartland_housing_cost.value: San Francisco metro median home price $1.27M vs Midwest $265,000
coastal_vs_heartland_housing_cost.note: Coastal premium driven by tech/finance labor markets and zoning restrictions

blue_red_state_political_divide.value: Democrat states average $74,200 household income vs Republican $65,400
blue_red_state_political_divide.source: U.S. Census ACS 2023 / MIT Election Data Lab
blue_red_state_political_divide.note: Income gap partly reflects urban/rural distribution within states

urban_rural_obesity_gap.note: Rural areas also have less healthcare access; Appalachian rates exceed 40%

sunbelt_population_growth.value: Texas +470K, Florida +365K net domestic migration in 2023
sunbelt_population_growth.note: Major shift from Northeast/Midwest; driven by cost, climate, no income tax
